LADYBUG LAPS - a RetroStone VC game for Windows
(c) 2026 Pierre-Louis Boyer (8BCraft). Code MIT, art/music/sound CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: see LICENSE-ladybuglaps.txt.

Tiny ladybugs race round the garden table and through the garden: round
teacups and sugar cubes, across spilt jam (sticky) and puddles (slippery),
under the leaves, over a spoon or a twig (hop!). Four racers, always: you and
three bots (Ruby, Sunny, Bluebell and Basil). The screen follows the leader:
fall too far behind and you are left behind - the leader takes the point and
you are put back behind it. Fall off the table and you lose a moment. Three
laps a race; the places at the line score 3, 2, 1, 0 more. Finish in the top 3
to go on: ten races, the five tracks, then the five again the other way round.
Medals at 20, 80, 160 and 280 points, and your best is kept.

Run LadybugLaps.exe. No installation needed (SDL2 is built in).

Controls                  Gamepad (SNES layout)      Keyboard
  steer                     D-pad: the ladybug turns   arrow keys
                            toward the direction held
  go (gas)                  A                          X
  brake / reverse           B                          Z
  start                     A (or B, Start, D-pad)     X or Enter
  pause / resume            Select (or Start in a race) Backspace or Esc
  players 2-4 join          A on their pad, on the title (B leaves)
  next race, back to title  A on the results and on the panel
  touch / mouse             a finger down on the left part and dragged: a
                            stick (the ladybug turns that way and drives on
                            while the finger is down); the round BRAKE button
                            at the bottom right; a tap starts and goes on

Up to four players (red, yellow, blue and green) race on one screen, each with
their own pad, with bots for the free places: a cup of three races, and the
results rank the players by their points.

F11 or Alt+Enter: fullscreen. F12: screenshot. Close the window to quit.
Options: LadybugLaps.exe --scale 4 --fullscreen
The best score is saved in ladybuglaps.srm next to the exe.
